docs.title: MysLib
docs.text:
Version: 0.1.4

A comprehensive Roblox utility library providing essential tools for game development, written in Luau.

AI-Assisted Documentation

Documentation is AI-Assisted and may contain inaccuracies. Please report any issues or suggestions on the GitHub Issues Page.

docs.title: What is MysLib?
docs.text: MysLib is a collection of battle-tested utilities and systems designed to streamline Roblox game development. Whether you're building combat systems, managing resources, detecting collisions, or manipulating game objects, MysLib provides clean, efficient APIs.

docs.title: Core Systems
docs.text: Signal — Custom event/signal system for decoupled communication Maid — Resource cleanup and connection management Hitbox — Advanced collision detection (square, sphere, part-based, projectile) Debris — Scheduled object destruction AttributeModifier — Instance attribute manipulation with undo support Bootstrapper — Module loading and initialization waitForChild — Enhanced child waiting with timeout and warnings

docs.title: Utility Modules
docs.text: StringUtil — String formatting, text abbreviation, time formatting, rich text MathUtil — Interpolation, Bézier curves, random numbers PhysicsUtil — Velocity, orientation, and vector utilities ParticleUtil — Particle and beam effect management TableUtil — Deep table copying and manipulation ModelUtil — Part selection and welding PlayerUtil — Player info, platform detection, raycasting GeneralUtil — Heartbeat/stepped connections, conditional yielding

docs.title: Quick Start
docs.text:
rojo build -o MysLib.rbxlx
Place MysLib.rbxlx in your game's ReplicatedStorage folder. 
local MysLib = require(path.to.MysLib)

-- Use Signal for events
local signal = MysLib.Signal.new()
signal:Connect(function(value)
    print("Signal fired:", value)
end)
signal:Fire(42)

-- Use Maid for cleanup
local maid = MysLib.Maid.new()
maid:GiveTask(connection)
maid:Destroy() -- Cleans up all tasks

See Getting Started for more examples.

docs.title: Installation
docs.text: You may install MysLib in one of two ways:

docs.title: Rojo
docs.text:
1. Git clone or download the repository onto your computer
  2. Run rojo build --o MysLib.rbxlx
  3. Copy 'MysLib' in ReplicatedStorage into your desired location

docs.title: Wally
docs.text:
1. Edit your wally.toml file to include the following: 
    [dependencies]
myslib = "mystifine/myslib@0.1.4"
  2. Run wally install

docs.title: Importing MysLib
docs.text:
In your scripts, require the library:

local MysLib = require(game.ServerScriptService.MysLib)

All modules are exposed as properties:

local Signal = MysLib.Signal
local Maid = MysLib.Maid
local Hitbox = MysLib.Hitbox
local StringUtil = MysLib.StringUtil

docs.title: Event System with Signal
docs.text:
local signal = MysLib.Signal.new()

-- Connect a listener
local connection = signal:Connect(function(player, damage)
    print(player.Name .. " took " .. damage .. " damage")
end)

-- Fire the signal
signal:Fire(player, 50)

-- Disconnect when done
connection:Disconnect()

docs.title: Resource Cleanup with Maid
docs.text:
local maid = MysLib.Maid.new()

-- Add various tasks
maid:GiveTask(connection)  -- Disconnect signals
maid:GiveTask(instance)    -- Destroy objects
maid:GiveTask(function()
    print("Cleanup")
end)

-- Clean everything up
maid:Destroy()

docs.title: Collision Detection with Hitbox
docs.text:
local hitbox = MysLib.Hitbox.sphere({
    cframe = workspace.Weapon.CFrame,
    radius = 20,
    onHit = function(part)
        print("Hit:", part.Name)
    end
})

hitbox:Start()  -- Begin detection
task.wait(5)
hitbox:Stop()   -- Stop detection
hitbox:Destroy()

docs.title: Utility Examples
docs.text:
-- String abbreviation
print(MysLib.StringUtil.abbrev(1500))     -- "1.5K"
print(MysLib.StringUtil.abbrev(1000000))  -- "1M"

-- Format time
print(MysLib.StringUtil.formatTime(3665)) -- "1h 1m 5s"

-- Deep copy
local copy = MysLib.TableUtil.deepCopy(originalTable)

-- Math interpolation
local value = MysLib.MathUtil.lerp(0, 100, 0.5) -- 50

For detailed API documentation, see the Core Systems and Utilities sections.

docs.title: AttributeModifier
docs.text: Instance attribute manipulation with undo support. Easily modify and revert attribute changes.

docs.title: Creating a Modifier
docs.text:
local modifier = MysLib.AttributeModifier.new(instance, "Health")

The modifier tracks the current value of the attribute.

docs.title: SetValue
docs.text:
Sets the attribute to a new value and returns an undo function.

local undo = modifier:SetValue(100)

-- Revert the change
undo.Undo()

Returns: Table with Undo() method

docs.title: IncrementValue
docs.text:
Increments the attribute value and returns an undo function.

local undo = modifier:IncrementValue(10)

-- Revert the increment
undo.Undo()

Returns: Table with Undo() method

docs.title: Destroy
docs.text:
Destroys the modifier and removes it from cache.

modifier:Destroy()

docs.title: Damage System
docs.text:
local MysLib = require(MysLib)

local function damagePlayer(character, amount)
    local healthModifier = MysLib.AttributeModifier.new(character, "Health")
    local undo = healthModifier:IncrementValue(-amount)

    if character:GetAttribute("Health") <= 0 then
        print("Player defeated")
    end
end

damagePlayer(character, 25)

docs.title: Reversible Changes
docs.text:
local modifier = MysLib.AttributeModifier.new(part, "CustomValue")

local undo1 = modifier:SetValue(50)
print(part:GetAttribute("CustomValue"))  -- 50

local undo2 = modifier:SetValue(100)
print(part:GetAttribute("CustomValue"))  -- 100

undo2.Undo()
print(part:GetAttribute("CustomValue"))  -- 50

undo1.Undo()
print(part:GetAttribute("CustomValue"))  -- (original value)

docs.title: Status Effects
docs.text:
local speedModifier = MysLib.AttributeModifier.new(character, "Speed")
local slowUndo = speedModifier:SetValue(10)

print("Slowed down")
task.wait(5)

slowUndo.Undo()
print("Speed restored")

docs.title: Bootstrapper
docs.text: Module loading and initialization with error protection. Safely load game modules at startup.

docs.title: loadModule
docs.text:
Loads and executes a module's main() function with error protection.

MysLib.Bootstrapper.loadModule(name, module)

Parameters: - name — Identifier for logging (e.g., "GameServer") - module — The ModuleScript to load

The module must export a main() function. Any errors are caught and logged without crashing.

docs.title: errorHandler
docs.text:
Formats error messages with traceback for debugging.

local traceback = MysLib.Bootstrapper.errorHandler(error)

docs.title: Basic Setup
docs.text:
local MysLib = require(MysLib)
local Bootstrapper = MysLib.Bootstrapper

-- Load game modules
Bootstrapper.loadModule("GameServer", workspace.GameModule)
Bootstrapper.loadModule("PlayerManager", workspace.PlayerModule)

docs.title: Module with main()
docs.text:
Create a module that exports a main() function:

-- MyModule.lua
local MyModule = {}

function MyModule.main()
    print("Module initialized")
    -- Setup code here
end

return MyModule

docs.title: Error Handling
docs.text:
If a module crashes, it logs the error without stopping the game:

Bootstrapper.loadModule("CrashingModule", workspace.BadModule)
-- Output: [warning] CrashingModule.loadModule => Failed to load module...
-- Game continues running

docs.title: Debris
docs.text: Scheduled object destruction. Automatically destroy instances or tables after a delay.

docs.title: AddItem
docs.text:
Schedules an object for destruction after a specified delay.

MysLib.Debris.AddItem(instance, 3)  -- Destroy after 3 seconds

Accepts: - Instance — Destroyed using Instance:Destroy() - Table — Cleaned up using maid cleanup rules

docs.title: RemoveItem
docs.text:
Removes a scheduled item before it's destroyed.

MysLib.Debris.RemoveItem(instance)  -- Cancel destruction

docs.title: Temporary Effects
docs.text:
local MysLib = require(MysLib)

local effect = Instance.new("Part")
effect.Parent = workspace

-- Destroy after 2 seconds
MysLib.Debris.AddItem(effect, 2)

docs.title: Cleanup
docs.text:
-- Schedule a sound for cleanup after it finishes
local sound = Instance.new("Sound")
sound.Parent = workspace
sound:Play()

MysLib.Debris.AddItem(sound, sound.TimeLength)

docs.title: Cancel Destruction
docs.text:
local item = Instance.new("Part")
MysLib.Debris.AddItem(item, 5)

task.wait(2)

-- Changed mind - keep it
MysLib.Debris.RemoveItem(item)

docs.title: Hitbox
docs.text: Advanced collision detection system supporting multiple shapes: squares, spheres, parts, and projectiles. Each hitbox can run once or continuously, with optional debug visualization.

docs.title: Square Hitbox
docs.text:
Detects collisions within a rectangular box.

local hitbox = MysLib.Hitbox.square({
    cframe = workspace.Part.CFrame,
    size = Vector3.new(10, 10, 10),
    onHit = function(part)
        print("Hit:", part.Name)
    end
})

docs.title: Sphere Hitbox
docs.text:
Detects collisions within a radius.

local hitbox = MysLib.Hitbox.sphere({
    cframe = workspace.Part.CFrame,
    radius = 20,
    onHit = function(part)
        print("Hit:", part.Name)
    end
})

docs.title: BasePart Hitbox
docs.text:
Uses an existing part's shape and size for collision detection.

local hitbox = MysLib.Hitbox.basePart({
    basePart = workspace.HitboxPart,
    onHit = function(part)
        print("Hit:", part.Name)
    end
})

docs.title: Projectile Hitbox
docs.text:
Raycasts along a path with velocity for projectile detection.

local projectile = MysLib.Hitbox.projectile({
    cframe = workspace.Weapon.CFrame,
    velocity = 100,
    lifetime = 5,
    width = 2,
    height = 2,
    onHit = function(result)
        print("Hit:", result.Instance.Name)
    end
})

docs.title: Methods
docs.text: All hitbox types support:

docs.title: Start
docs.text:
Begins continuous collision detection every frame.

hitbox:Start()

docs.title: Stop
docs.text:
Stops continuous collision detection.

hitbox:Stop()

docs.title: Cast
docs.text:
Performs a single collision check without continuous monitoring.

hitbox:Cast()

docs.title: Destroy
docs.text:
Destroys the hitbox and cleans up resources.

hitbox:Destroy()

docs.title: Common Options
docs.text:
All hitbox types accept these configuration options:

{
    onHit = function(part) end,           -- Callback when collision detected (required)
    ignoreList = {part1, part2},          -- Parts to ignore
    visualize = true,                     -- Show debug visualization
    visualizeColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 0),
    visualizeTransparency = 0.8,
    visualizeDuration = 0.5
}

docs.title: raycast
docs.text:
Performs a raycast with optional debug visualization.

local result = MysLib.Hitbox.raycast(
    origin,           -- Vector3
    direction,        -- Vector3
    raycastParams,
    visualize,        -- boolean?
    visualizeColor,   -- Color3?
    visualizeTransparency,  -- number?
    visualizeDuration -- number?
)

docs.title: spherecast
docs.text:
Performs a spherecast with optional debug visualization.

local result = MysLib.Hitbox.spherecast(
    position,
    radius,
    direction,
    raycastParams,
    visualize,
    visualizeColor,
    visualizeTransparency,
    visualizeDuration
)

docs.title: getClosestTarget
docs.text:
Finds the closest target from a list of models.

local targets = {enemy1 = true, enemy2 = true}
local closest = MysLib.Hitbox.getClosestTarget(position, targets)

docs.title: Melee Weapon
docs.text:
local weapon = workspace.Weapon
local hitbox = MysLib.Hitbox.sphere({
    cframe = weapon.CFrame,
    radius = 5,
    onHit = function(part)
        if part.Parent:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") then
            part.Parent.Humanoid:TakeDamage(25)
        end
    end
})

hitbox:Start()
task.wait(1)
hitbox:Stop()

docs.title: Projectile Attack
docs.text:
local projectile = MysLib.Hitbox.projectile({
    cframe = weapon.CFrame,
    velocity = 100,
    lifetime = 5,
    width = 1,
    height = 1,
    visualize = true,
    onHit = function(result)
        local part = result.Instance
        local humanoid = part.Parent:FindFirstChild("Humanoid")
        if humanoid then
            humanoid:TakeDamage(50)
        end
    end
})

projectile:Start()

docs.title: Debug Visualization
docs.text:
local hitbox = MysLib.Hitbox.sphere({
    cframe = CFrame.new(0, 10, 0),
    radius = 20,
    visualize = true,
    visualizeColor = Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 0),
    visualizeTransparency = 0.5,
    visualizeDuration = 1,
    onHit = function(part) print("Hit:", part.Name) end
})

hitbox:Cast()  -- Shows visualization for 1 second

docs.title: Maid
docs.text: Resource cleanup and connection management. Simplifies cleanup of multiple connections, instances, or tasks.

docs.title: Creating a Maid
docs.text: local maid = MysLib.Maid.new()

docs.title: GiveTask / AddTask
docs.text:
Adds a task to the maid for cleanup. Accepts: - Functions — Called when cleaned - RBXScriptConnection — Disconnected when cleaned - Objects with Destroy method — Destroy() called when cleaned - Objects with Disconnect method — Disconnect() called when cleaned

local maid = MysLib.Maid.new()

-- Add function
maid:GiveTask(function()
    print("Cleanup!")
end)

-- Add connection
maid:GiveTask(connection)

-- Add instance
maid:GiveTask(instance)

-- AddTask is an alias
maid:AddTask(connection)

docs.title: Destroy / DoCleaning
docs.text:
Cleans up all tasks in the maid: - Functions are called - Connections are disconnected - Instances are destroyed

maid:Destroy()

-- DoCleaning is an alias
maid:DoCleaning()

docs.title: Managing Connections
docs.text:
local maid = MysLib.Maid.new()

-- Add multiple connections
maid:GiveTask(RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
    print("Heartbeat")
end))

maid:GiveTask(UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
    print("Input:", input.KeyCode)
end))

-- Clean all at once
maid:Destroy()

docs.title: Object Lifecycle
docs.text:
local character = player.Character
local maid = MysLib.Maid.new()

-- Add cleanup callbacks
maid:GiveTask(function()
    print("Character cleanup")
end)

-- Add the character - when Destroy() is called, character is destroyed
maid:GiveTask(character)

-- Later...
maid:Destroy()  -- Prints message and destroys character

docs.title: Scope-based Cleanup
docs.text:
local function setupUI()
    local maid = MysLib.Maid.new()

    local button = Instance.new("TextButton")
    maid:GiveTask(button)

    maid:GiveTask(button.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        print("Clicked")
    end))

    return maid
end

local uiMaid = setupUI()
uiMaid:Destroy()  -- All UI cleaned up

docs.title: Signal
docs.text: A custom event/signal system for decoupled communication. Similar to Roblox's BindableEvent, but with additional features like Once() and Wait().

docs.title: Creating a Signal
docs.text: local signal = MysLib.Signal.new()

docs.title: Connect
docs.text:
Connects a callback function that fires every time the signal fires.

local connection = signal:Connect(function(value)
    print("Signal fired:", value)
end)

connection:Disconnect()

Returns: SignalConnection — Object with Disconnect() method

docs.title: Fire
docs.text:
Fires the signal, calling all connected callbacks with the provided arguments.

signal:Fire("hello", 42)
signal:Fire(player, damage)

docs.title: Once
docs.text:
Connects a callback that fires only once, then automatically disconnects.

signal:Once(function(value)
    print("Only fires once:", value)
end)

signal:Fire(1)  -- Prints
signal:Fire(2)  -- Doesn't print

Returns: SignalConnection — Can be manually disconnected if needed

docs.title: Wait
docs.text:
Yields the current thread until the signal fires and returns the arguments passed to Fire().

local value = signal:Wait()
print("Signal fired with:", value)

Useful for waiting on one-time events without creating a connection.

docs.title: Simple Event System
docs.text:
local MysLib = require(MysLib)
local Signal = MysLib.Signal

local playerDamagedSignal = Signal.new()

-- Listener
playerDamagedSignal:Connect(function(player, damage)
    print(player.Name .. " took " .. damage .. " damage")
end)

-- Trigger
playerDamagedSignal:Fire(player, 50)

docs.title: Multiple Listeners
docs.text:
local signal = Signal.new()

signal:Connect(function(x)
    print("Listener 1:", x)
end)

signal:Connect(function(x)
    print("Listener 2:", x)
end)

signal:Fire(42)  -- Both listeners print

docs.title: Wait for Event
docs.text:
task.spawn(function()
    local value = signal:Wait()
    print("Signal fired with:", value)
end)

task.wait(1)
signal:Fire("hello")  -- Wakes up the spawn

docs.title: waitForChild
docs.text: Enhanced child waiting with timeout and warnings. Safer alternative to Instance:WaitForChild().

docs.title: Function
docs.text:
local child = MysLib.waitForChild(parent, "ChildName", timeOut)

Parameters: - parent — The instance to search in - childName — Name of the child to find - timeOut — Maximum time to wait (optional, default: infinity)

Returns: The child instance, or nil if timeout or parent destroyed

docs.title: Features
docs.text:
• Automatically warns if waiting exceeds 30 seconds
  • Supports timeout (unlike built-in WaitForChild)
  • Returns nil if parent is destroyed while waiting
  • More reliable than built-in version

docs.title: Simple Wait
docs.text:
local child = MysLib.waitForChild(workspace, "MyPart")
if child then
    print("Found:", child.Name)
end

docs.title: With Timeout
docs.text:
local child = MysLib.waitForChild(script.Parent, "Config", 5)

if child then
    print("Found config")
else
    print("Config not found within 5 seconds")
end

docs.title: Wait with Safety
docs.text:
local humanoidRootPart = MysLib.waitForChild(character, "HumanoidRootPart", 10)

if humanoidRootPart then
    print("Character loaded")
else
    print("Character failed to load - may have been destroyed")
end

docs.title: Check Before Timeout
docs.text:
-- Wait 30 seconds, will warn if exceeds 30 seconds
local sound = MysLib.waitForChild(script, "SoundEffect", 60)

docs.title: GeneralUtil
docs.text: General utilities for heartbeat connections, stepped events, and logging.

docs.title: Heartbeat
docs.text:
Manages heartbeat callbacks with cooldown system.

local heartbeat = MysLib.GeneralUtil.Heartbeat.new(function(elapsed)
    print("Heartbeat elapsed:", elapsed)
end, 0.5)  -- Run every 0.5 seconds

heartbeat:Disconnect()

Parameters: - callback — Function called each heartbeat, receives elapsed time - cooldown — Minimum time between calls (default: 0)

docs.title: Stepped
docs.text:
Similar to Heartbeat but runs on Stepped event.

local stepped = MysLib.GeneralUtil.Stepped.new(function(elapsed)
    print("Stepped")
end, 0.1)

stepped:Disconnect()

docs.title: yieldWhileCondition
docs.text:
Yields the thread until a condition becomes false.

MysLib.GeneralUtil.yieldWhileCondition(function()
    return character.Humanoid.Health > 0
end)
print("Character died")

docs.title: warn
docs.text:
Custom warning function.

MysLib.GeneralUtil.warn("Something went wrong")

docs.title: Heartbeat Loop
docs.text:
local heartbeat = MysLib.GeneralUtil.Heartbeat.new(function(elapsed)
    character.PrimaryPart.Position = character.PrimaryPart.Position + Vector3.new(0, 0, 1)
end)

task.wait(10)
heartbeat:Disconnect()

docs.title: Wait for Condition
docs.text:
task.spawn(function()
    MysLib.GeneralUtil.yieldWhileCondition(function()
        return player.Character ~= nil
    end)
    print("Player respawned")
end)

docs.title: MathUtil
docs.text: Mathematical utilities for calculations, interpolation, and Bézier curves.

docs.title: truncate
docs.text:
Truncates a number to a specified number of decimal places.

MysLib.MathUtil.truncate(3.14159, 2)   -- 3.14
MysLib.MathUtil.truncate(2.99999, 1)   -- 2.9

docs.title: randomNumber / rng
docs.text:
Generates a random number between min and max (inclusive).

MysLib.MathUtil.randomNumber(1, 10)    -- Random float between 1 and 10
MysLib.MathUtil.rng(0, 100)            -- Alias for randomNumber

docs.title: lerp
docs.text:
Performs linear interpolation between two values.

MysLib.MathUtil.lerp(0, 100, 0.5)      -- 50
MysLib.MathUtil.lerp(10, 20, 0.25)     -- 12.5

Parameter: c is the interpolation factor (0 to 1) - 0 = start value - 0.5 = midpoint - 1 = end value

docs.title: quadBezier
docs.text:
Calculates a quadratic Bézier curve value.

MysLib.MathUtil.quadBezier(0.5, 0, 50, 100)  -- Midpoint of curve

Parameters: - t — Curve parameter (0 to 1) - p0 — Start point - p1 — Control point - p2 — End point

docs.title: cubicBezier
docs.text:
Calculates a cubic Bézier curve value.

MysLib.MathUtil.cubicBezier(0.5, 0, 25, 75, 100)  -- Midpoint of curve

Parameters: - t — Curve parameter (0 to 1) - p0 — Start point - p1 — First control point - p2 — Second control point - p3 — End point

docs.title: Smooth Animation
docs.text:
-- Animate a value from 0 to 100 over time
for t = 0, 1, 0.01 do
    local value = MysLib.MathUtil.lerp(0, 100, t)
    print(value)
end

docs.title: Random Damage
docs.text:
local baseDamage = 50
local variance = 20
local actualDamage = baseDamage + MysLib.MathUtil.randomNumber(-variance, variance)

docs.title: Smooth Curves
docs.text:
-- Create smooth motion with cubic Bézier
local position = MysLib.MathUtil.cubicBezier(t, startX, cp1X, cp2X, endX)

docs.title: ModelUtil
docs.text: Model utilities for part selection, welding, and assembly.

docs.title: getModelLargestPart
docs.text:
Finds the largest part in a model by volume.

local largest = MysLib.ModelUtil.getModelLargestPart(model)

docs.title: weldConstraint
docs.text:
Creates a weld constraint between two parts with optional offset.

MysLib.ModelUtil.weldConstraint(part1, part2)
MysLib.ModelUtil.weldConstraint(part1, part2, offset)

docs.title: weldModel
docs.text:
Welds all parts in a model together to a primary part.

MysLib.ModelUtil.weldModel(model)

Automatically selects the largest part as the primary and welds all others to it.

docs.title: Ragdoll Assembly
docs.text:
local ragdoll = workspace:FindFirstChild("Ragdoll")
MysLib.ModelUtil.weldModel(ragdoll)  -- Hold it together

docs.title: Find Model Anchor
docs.text:
local model = workspace:FindFirstChild("Building")
local largest = MysLib.ModelUtil.getModelLargestPart(model)
print("Anchor to:", largest.Name)

docs.title: Custom Assembly
docs.text:
local wheel = workspace:FindFirstChild("Wheel")
local axle = workspace:FindFirstChild("Axle")
MysLib.ModelUtil.weldConstraint(wheel, axle)

docs.title: ParticleUtil
docs.text: Particle and beam effect management utilities.

docs.title: emitParticle
docs.text:
Emits a single particle from a specific location.

MysLib.ParticleUtil.emitParticle(particle, part)

docs.title: playParticleEffects
docs.text:
Plays all particle emitters in a part and its descendants.

MysLib.ParticleUtil.playParticleEffects(part)

docs.title: setParticlesEnabled
docs.text:
Enables or disables all particle emitters in a part.

MysLib.ParticleUtil.setParticlesEnabled(part, true)   -- Enable
MysLib.ParticleUtil.setParticlesEnabled(part, false)  -- Disable

docs.title: setBeamsEnabled
docs.text:
Enables or disables all beam emitters in a part.

MysLib.ParticleUtil.setBeamsEnabled(part, true)   -- Enable
MysLib.ParticleUtil.setBeamsEnabled(part, false)  -- Disable

docs.title: clearAllParticles
docs.text:
Clears all particles and beams from a part and its descendants.

MysLib.ParticleUtil.clearAllParticles(part)

docs.title: Trigger Effect
docs.text:
local effect = workspace:FindFirstChild("ExplosionEffect")
MysLib.ParticleUtil.playParticleEffects(effect)

docs.title: Hide Effects
docs.text:
local spell = workspace:FindFirstChild("SpellEffect")
MysLib.ParticleUtil.setParticlesEnabled(spell, false)

docs.title: Cleanup Effects
docs.text:
local oldEffect = workspace:FindFirstChild("OldEffect")
MysLib.ParticleUtil.clearAllParticles(oldEffect)
oldEffect:Destroy()

docs.title: PhysicsUtil
docs.text: Physics utilities for velocity, orientation, and vector calculations.

docs.title: Velocity
docs.text:
Manages linear velocity constraints with priority system and automatic cleanup.

local vel = MysLib.PhysicsUtil.Velocity.new(
    part,                           -- BasePart to apply velocity to
    Vector3.new(100, 100, 100),    -- MaxForce per axis
    Vector3.new(50, 0, 0),         -- Initial velocity
    5,                              -- Duration in seconds (-1 for infinite)
    1                               -- Priority (higher overrides lower)
)

vel:SetVelocity(Vector3.new(100, 50, 0))
vel:SetMaxForce(Vector3.new(200, 200, 200))

task.wait(5)
vel:Destroy()

docs.title: Methods
docs.text: SetVelocity — Update the velocity vector SetMaxForce — Update the maximum force per axis Destroy — Stop and clean up

docs.title: Orientation
docs.text: Handles angular velocity and rotation constraints.

docs.title: getHorizontalNormalizedVector
docs.text:
Calculates a normalized 2D vector (ignoring Y axis).

local direction = MysLib.PhysicsUtil.getHorizontalNormalizedVector(vector)

docs.title: Character Knockback
docs.text:
local knockbackVelocity = MysLib.PhysicsUtil.Velocity.new(
    character.PrimaryPart,
    Vector3.new(math.huge, 0, math.huge),
    direction * 50,
    0.5  -- Apply for half a second
)

docs.title: Movement System
docs.text:
local movementVel = MysLib.PhysicsUtil.Velocity.new(
    humanoidRootPart,
    Vector3.new(100, 0, 100),
    moveDirection * speed,
    -1  -- Infinite duration
)

-- Update movement each frame
RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
    movementVel:SetVelocity(moveDirection * speed)
end)

docs.title: PlayerUtil
docs.text: Player-related utilities for character checks, platform detection, and user info.

docs.title: isCharacterAlive
docs.text:
Checks if a character model is alive and valid.

if MysLib.PlayerUtil.isCharacterAlive(player.Character) then
    print("Character is alive!")
end

Validates: - Character exists and is in workspace - Humanoid exists and health > 0 - Humanoid is not in Dead state - PrimaryPart exists and is part of character

docs.title: getPlayerPlatform
docs.text:
Detects which platform the player is using. Client-only function.

local platform = MysLib.PlayerUtil.getPlayerPlatform()
if platform == "Mobile" then
    -- Handle mobile-specific code
elseif platform == "Console" then
    -- Console controls
else
    -- Desktop
end

Returns: "Console", "Mobile", or "Desktop"

docs.title: getPlayerNameFromUserId
docs.text:
Gets a player's username from their user ID.

local name = MysLib.PlayerUtil.getPlayerNameFromUserId(123456789)
print(name)  -- "PlayerName"

docs.title: getPlayerThumbnailFromUserId
docs.text:
Gets a player's avatar thumbnail URL from their user ID.

local thumbnail = MysLib.PlayerUtil.getPlayerThumbnailFromUserId(123456789)
-- Use in GUI ImageLabel.Image = thumbnail

docs.title: getMouseHit
docs.text:
Gets the mouse position in 3D space. Client-only function.

local position = MysLib.PlayerUtil.getMouseHit()
print(position)  -- Vector3 position

docs.title: Check Before Action
docs.text:
if MysLib.PlayerUtil.isCharacterAlive(targetCharacter) then
    targetCharacter.Humanoid:TakeDamage(25)
else
    print("Character is not alive")
end

docs.title: StringUtil
docs.text: String utilities for text manipulation and formatting.

docs.title: abbrev
docs.text:
Abbreviates large numbers to a shorter format with suffixes (K, M, B, T, etc.).

MysLib.StringUtil.abbrev(1500)      -- "1.5K"
MysLib.StringUtil.abbrev(1000000)   -- "1M"
MysLib.StringUtil.abbrev(1234567)   -- "1.2M"

docs.title: addCommas
docs.text:
Formats a number with comma separators for thousands.

MysLib.StringUtil.addCommas(1000000)   -- "1,000,000"
MysLib.StringUtil.addCommas(50000)     -- "50,000"

docs.title: formatTime
docs.text:
Converts seconds to a human-readable time format.

MysLib.StringUtil.formatTime(3665)      -- "0d 1h 1m 5s"
MysLib.StringUtil.formatTime(120)       -- "0d 0h 2m 0s"
MysLib.StringUtil.formatTime(86400)     -- "1d 0h 0m 0s"

docs.title: RichText
docs.text: Sub-module for rich text formatting (color, bold, size, etc.).

docs.title: Leaderboard Display
docs.text:
local score = 12345678
local formatted = MysLib.StringUtil.abbrev(score)  -- "12.3M"
print("Score: " .. formatted)

docs.title: Countdown Timer
docs.text:
local timeRemaining = 172800  -- 2 days
local display = MysLib.StringUtil.formatTime(timeRemaining)  -- "2d 0h 0m 0s"
print("Time remaining: " .. display)

docs.title: Currency Display
docs.text:
local money = 5000000
print("$" .. MysLib.StringUtil.addCommas(money))  -- "$5,000,000"

docs.title: TableUtil
docs.text: Table utilities for deep copying and manipulation.

docs.title: deepCopy
docs.text:
Recursively copies a table and all nested tables. Modifying the copy won't affect the original.

local original = {a = 1, b = {c = 2}}
local copy = MysLib.TableUtil.deepCopy(original)

copy.b.c = 99
print(original.b.c)  -- Still 2
print(copy.b.c)      -- 99

docs.title: Duplicating Complex Data
docs.text:
local playerTemplate = {
    health = 100,
    inventory = {
        sword = true,
        shield = true
    },
    stats = {
        attack = 10,
        defense = 5
    }
}

local player1 = MysLib.TableUtil.deepCopy(playerTemplate)
local player2 = MysLib.TableUtil.deepCopy(playerTemplate)

player1.inventory.sword = false
print(player2.inventory.sword)  -- Still true

docs.title: Configuration Cloning
docs.text:
local baseConfig = {
    enabled = true,
    settings = {
        volume = 0.8,
        quality = "high"
    }
}

local customConfig = MysLib.TableUtil.deepCopy(baseConfig)
customConfig.settings.volume = 0.5
-- baseConfig remains unchanged
